senses.gloss: परि-पक्व mfn. completely cooked or dressed, W.
completely burnt (as bricks), Var.
quite ripe, mature, accomplished, perfect, MBh.; Kāv.; Suśr.
highly cultivated, very sharp or shrewd, SaddhP.
near death or decay, about to pass away, MBh.; Suśr.
fully digested, W.
परि-पक्व—कषाय mfn. = जितेन्द्रिय, Kull. on Mn. vi, 1
परि-पक्व—ता f. being dressed or cooked, maturity
digestion
perfection
shrewdness, W.
परि-पक्व—शालि m. ripe rice, Ṛt,
परि-पचन n. = तैलपाचनिका, Car., Sch.
परि-पाचन mfn. cooking, ripening, Suśr.
(fig.) bringing to maturity, Lalit.
परि-पाचन, n. and परि-पाचन—ता, f. the act of bringing to m˚, Lalit.
परि-पाक m. being completely cooked or dressed, Bhpr.
digestion, Vedāntas.
ripening, maturity, perfection, Kāv.; Sāṃkhyak.; Suśr.
result, consequence (आत् and अतस्, in c˚ of), Mcar.; Rājat.
cleverness, shrewdness, experience, Naiṣ. (cf. परी-प्˚).
परि-पाक ˚किन् &c. See परि-पच्.
परी—पाक m. ripening, maturing, full development, Suśr.; Car.; Kāraṇḍ.
the result or consequences of anything, Mcar. (cf. परि-प्˚).
परि-पाकिन् mfn. ripening, digesting, W.
परि-पाकिनी f. Ipomoea Turpethum, L.
परि-पाचन, n. and परि-पाचन—ता, f. the act of bringing to m˚, Lalit.
परि-पाचयितृ mfn. cooking, ripening, Megh., Sch.
परि-पाचित mfn. cooked, roasted, Suśr.

परि-√ पठ् P. -पठति, to discourse, Sarvad.;
to enumerate completely, detail, mention, name, MBh.; Suśr.; Pur.
परि-पाठ m. complete enumeration
परि-पाठेन ind. in detail, completely, MBh.
परि-पाठक mfn. enumerating completely, detailing, Cat.
परि-पण m. n. (√ पण्) = नीवी (capital, stock ?), L.
परि-पा॑ण n. protection, defence, covert, RV.
परि-पणन n. playing for, wagering, Mudr.
परि-पणित mfn. pledged, wagered, promised, W.
परि-पण्डिमन् m. complete whiteness, Śiś.
परि-पाण्डिमन् m. excessive pallor or whiteness, Śiś.
परि-पतन n. flying round or about, Śak.
प॑रि-पति m. the lord of all around, RV.; VS. (Mahīdh. ‘flying about’).
परि-√ पद् Caus. -पादयति, to change (म् before र् and the sibilants) into Anu-svāra, RPrāt.
परि-प॑द् f. a trap or snare, RV.
परि-पदिन् m. an enemy, L. (w.r. for ˚परिन् ?).
परि-पन्न n. the change of म् into Anusvāra (cf. above), RPrāt.
परि-पा॑न n. a drink, beverage, RV.
पारि—पान n. drink (?), Divyāv.
परि-पाद m. g. निरुदकादि.
परि-पन्थक m. (√ पन्थ्) one who obstructs the way, an antagonist, adversary, enemy, Rājat.
परि-पन्थम् ind. by or in the way, L.
परि-पन्थय Nom. P. ˚यति, to obstruct the way, oppose, resist (with acc.), Rājat.
परि-पन्थिक m. an adversary, enemy, MBh.
पारि—पन्थिक m. (fr. परि-पन्थम्) a highwayman, robber, thief, L. (Pāṇ. iv, 4, 36).
पारि—पान्थिक w.r. for -पन्थिक above.
परि-पन्थि॑न् mfn. standing in the way, hindering
परि-पन्थि॑न् m. = prec. RV. &c. &c. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 2, 89)
परि-पन्˚थि-त्व n., Sāh.; Sarvad.
परि-पन्थी-√ भू to become the adversary of (gen.), Veṇīs.
परि-पर See अ-परि-पर.
परि-परि॑न् m. (prob. fr. परि + परि) an antagonist, adversary, VS. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 2, 89).
परि-पवन See परि-पू, col. 2.
परि-पवन n. cleaning, winnowing corn, Kull.
a winnowing basket, Nir.
प॑रि-पशव्य mfn. (पशु) relating to the sacrificial victim, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

परि-√ 1. पा P. -पिबति, to drink before or after (acc.), AitBr.;
to drink or suck out, take away, rob, Kād.
परि-√ 3. पा P. -पाति, (aor. Subj. -पासति, RV.), to protect or defend on every side, to guard, maintain, RV. &c. &c.
परि-पीत mfn. drunk or sucked out, gone through, Kāv.
soaked with (comp.), Suśr.
परि-पालक mf(इका)n. (cf. √ पाल्) guarding, keeping, maintaining, Pur.
taking care of one's property, SaddhP.
परि-पालन n. the act of guarding &c., Viṣṇ.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
fostering, nourishing, Pañc.
परि-पालना f. protection, care, nurture, Bālar.
परि-पालनीय mfn. to be guarded or preserved or kept or maintained, Kād.
परि-पालयितृ mfn. protecting, defending, Śaṃk.
परि-पाल्य mfn. = ˚पालनीय, MBh.; R. &c.
पारि—पाल्य n. governorship, Rājat.
परि-पिपालयिषा f. (fr. Desid. of Caus.) desire of protecting or sustaining or preserving, Śaṃk.
परि-पाटल mfn. of a pale red colour, pale red, Kālid.; Śiś. &c.
परि-पाट—लित m. dyed pale red, Hariv.
परि-पाटि f(इ or ई). succession, order, method, arrangement, Var.; Caṇḍ.; Bhām.; Sāh.
arithmetic, Col.
परि-पाण्डु mfn. very light or pale, Kālid.; Ratnāv.
परि-पाण्डुर mfn. dazzling white, Bālar.; Vcar.
परि-पाण्डुरित mfn. made very pale, ib.
परि-पार्श्व mfn. being at or by one's side, near, at hand, KātyŚr.
पारि—पार्श्व n. (prob.), retinue, attendants, bystanders (in a play), Hariv.
परि-पार्श्व—चर mfn. going at or by one's side, MBh.
परि-पार्श्व—तस् ind. at or by the side, on both sides of (gen.), MBh.; Hariv.
परि-पार्श्व—वर्तिन् mfn. being at the side or near, Kum.; Prab.
परि-पिङ्ग mfn. quite reddish-brown.
परि-पिङ्गी-√ कृ to dye reddish-brown, Śiś.
परि-पिच्छ n. an ornament made of the feathers of a peacock's tail, BhP.
परि-पिञ्ज mfn. full of (instr.), Kum.
परि-पिञ्जर mf(आ)n. of a brownish red colour, Kād.; Vcar.
परि-पिण्डी-कृत mfn. made up like a ball, Divyāv.
परि-√ पिष् (only pf. -पिपेष), to crush, pound, strike, R.
परि-पिष्ट mfn. crushed, trampled down, MBh.
परि-पिष्टक n. lead, L.
परि-पीडन n. squeezing or pressing out, Suśr.
injuring, prejudicing, Kām.
परि-पीडा f. pressing, tormenting, R.
परि-पीडित mfn. pressed
embraced
tormented, Kāv.
परि-पीवर mfn. very fat or plump, Hariv.
परि-पुङ्खित mfn. feathered (as an arrow), Bhām.
परि-पुच्छय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to wag the tail, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 20, Sch.
परि-√ पुट् Pass. -पुट्यते, to peel off, lose the bark or skin, Suśr.
परि-पुटन n. peeling, losing the bark or skin, ib.
परि-पुटन—वत् mfn. peeling or dropping off, ib.
परि-पोट m. peeling off (a partic. disease of the ear), Suśr.
परि-पोट &c. See परि-पुट्.
परि-पोट—क m. id., ib.
परि-पोट—वत् mfn. peeling off, losing the skin, ib.
परि-पोटन n. peeling off, desquamation, losing the bark or skin, ib.
परि-√ पुष् Caus. -पोषयति (Pass. pr. p. -पोष्यमाण), to nourish, foster.
परि-पुष्ट mfn. nourished, cherished (-ता f., Yājñ.)
amply provided with, abounding in (comp.), Kull.
augmented, increased, Sāh.
परि-पुष्ट—ता f., Yājñ.
परि-पोष m. full growth or development, Sāh.
परि-पोष &c. See परि-पुष्.
परि-पोषक mfn. nourishing, confirming, Rājat.
परि-पोषण n. the act of cherishing or furthering or promoting, BhP.
परि-पोषणीय mfn. to be nourished or promoted, Pañc.
परि-पुष्करा f. Cucumis Maderaspatanus, L.

परि-√ पू P. Ā. -पुनाति, ˚नीते, to purify completely, strain;
 Ā. (RV. -पवते), to flow off clearly.
परि-पूत mfn. purified, strained, winnowed, threshed, RV.; Mn. &c.
परि-पूति f. complete cleaning or purification, Bālar.
परि-√ पूज् P. -पूजयति, to honour greatly, adore, worship, MBh.; Kāv.
परि-पूजन n. honouring, adoring, W.
परि-पूजा f. id., MW.
परि-पूजित mfn. honoured, adored, worshipped, ib.
परि-पृच्छक &c. See परिप्रछ्.
परि-पृच्छक m. an interrogator, inquirer, GopBr.
परि-पूरक mfn. filling, fulfilling, Bhartṛ.
causing fulness or prosperity, Kull.
परि-पूरण n. the act of filling, Kāv.
accomplishing, perfecting, rendering complete, Śaṃk.; Kāraṇḍ.
परि-पूरणीय mfn. to be filled or fulfilled, Hcat.
परि-पूरयितव्य mfn. id., Kāraṇḍ.
परि-पूरित mfn. filled or occupied by, furnished with (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
accomplished, finished, gone through, experienced, Gīt.
परि-पूरिन् mfn. granting or bestowing richly, Śiś.
परि-पूर्ण mfn. quite full, Kauś.
completely filled or covered with, occupied by (comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
accomplished, perfect, whole, complete, ib.
fully satisfied, content, R.
परि-पूर्ण—चन्द्र-विमल-प्रभ m. N. of a Samādhi, L.
परि-पूर्ण—ता f. completion, fulness, satiety, satisfaction, L.
परि-पूर्ण—त्व n. completion, fulness, satiety, satisfaction, L.
परि-पूर्ण—भाषिन् mfn. speaking perfectly i.e. very wisely, R.
परि-पूर्ण—मानस mfn. satisfied in mind, R.
परि-पूर्ण—मुख mf(ई)n. having the face entirely covered or smeared or painted with (comp.), Caurap.
परि-पूर्ण—सहस्र-चन्द्र-वती f. ‘possessing a thousand full moons’, N. of Indra's wife, L.
परि-पूर्ण—व्यञ्जनता f. having the sexual organs complete (one of the 80 secondary marks of a Buddha), Dharmas. lxxxiv, 24
परि-पूर्ण-सत्त्व mfn. having absolute perfection, Bcar.
परि-पूर्˚णार्थ mfn. having attained one's aim, R.
full of meaning, wise (as a speech), MBh.; R.
परि-पूर्˚णेन्दु m. the full moon, Mṛcch.
परि-पूर्ति f. fulness, completion, RPrāt., Sch.
परि-पेलव mf(आ)n. very fine or small, very delicate, Var.
परि-पेलव n. (also -पेल, L.) Cyperus Rotundus or a similar kind of grass, Suśr.
परि-प्र-√ ग्रह् P. -गृह्णाति, to hand or pass round, KātyŚr.

परि-√ प्रछ् P. Ā. -पृच्छति, ˚ते (pf. -पप्रच्छ; fut. -प्रक्ष्यति; ind.p. -पृच्छ्य; inf. -प्रष्टुम्), to interrogate or ask a person about anything, to inquire about (with 2 acc. or with acc. of pers. and acc. with प्रति loc. or gen. of thing), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-पृच्छनिका f. a subject for discussion, Divyāv.
परि-पृच्छा f. question, inquiry, L.
परि-पृच्छिक mfn. one who receives anything only when asked for, MBh. (Nīlak.)
परि-पृष्टिक mfn. id., ib.
परि-प्रश्न m. question, interrogation, Bhag.
inquiry about (comp.), Pāṇ. ii, 1, 63 &c.
परि-प्रश्न See परि-प्रछ्.
परि-प्र-णी (√ नी, only Pass. -णीय॑ते) to fetch from (abl.), RV. i, 141, 4.
परि-√ प्रथ् (only pf. Ā. -पप्रथे॑), to stretch round or over (acc.), RV. vi, 7, 7.
परि-प्र-√ धन्व् (only Impv. धन्व), to run or stream about, RV.
परि-प्र-√ मुच् (only Impv. Ā. -मुञ्चस्व), to free one's self from (abl.), RV. x, 38, 5.
परि-प्र-√ या (only 2. pl. pr. -याथ॑), to travel round (acc.), RV. iv, 51, 5.
परि-प्र-√ वच् (only aor. -प्रवोचन्), to tell anything earlier than another person (acc.), ChUp. iv, 10, 2.
परि-प्र-√ वृत् Caus. -वर्तयति, to turn hither, RV. x, 135, 4.
परि-प्र-√ स्यन्द् Ā. -स्य॑न्दते (aor. P. -अ॑सिष्यदत्), to flow forth or round, RV.
परि-प्राप् (-प्र-√ आप्), Caus. -प्रापयति, to get done, bring about, accomplish, Lalit.; Divyāv.
परि-प्रापण n. taking place, occurrence, Pat.
परि-प्राप्ति f. obtaining, acquisition, R.
परि-प्राप्य mfn. to be done, Divyāv.
परि-प्रेप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to gain or obtain, desirous of (acc.), MBh.
परि-प्रार्ध n. proximity, nearness, ŚāṅkhBr.
परि-प्री॑ mfn. very dear, highly valued, RV.
प॑रि-प्रीत mfn. id., ib.
much gratified, delighted, MBh.
परि-√ प्रुष् (only pr. p. -प्रुष्ण॑त्), to sprinkle about, TS.
परि-प्रु॑ष् mfn. sprinkling, splashing, RV.
परि-प्रे (-प्र + √ इ, only pr. p. -प्रय॑त्), to run through on all sides, RV. ix, 68, 8.
परि-प्रेरक mfn. (√ ईर्) exciting, causing, effecting, Sāy.
परि-प्रेष् (-प्र- √ 1. इष्), Caus. प्रैषयति, to send forth, despatch, Bhaṭṭ.
परि-प्रेषण n. sending forth
abandoning, W.
परि-प्रेषित mfn. sent forth
abandoned, ib.
परि-प्रेष्य m. a servant, MBh. iv, 32 (v.l. परे प्र्˚).
परि-प्लव॑ mfn. swimming, VS.; Kāṭh.
swaying or moving to and fro, ŚāṅkhBr.
running about, unsteady, restless, Śiś.
परि-प्लव॑ m. trembling, restlessness, Bhpr.
bathing, inundation, W.
oppression, tyranny, ib.
a ship, boat, R. (v.l. पारिप्ल्˚)
N. of a prince (son of Sukhī-bala or Sukhī-vala or Sukhī-nala), Pur.
परि-प्लवा (आ), f. a sort of spoon used at sacrifices, KātyŚr.
पारि—प्लव mf(आ)n. swimming, MBh.; Kāv.
moving to and fro, agitated, unsteady, tremulous
wavering, irresolute, ib.
(पा॑रि-), ‘moving in a circle’, N. of partic. legends recited at the Aśva-medha and repeated at certain intervals throughout the year, ŚBr.; ŚrS.; Bādar.
पारि—प्लव m. a boat, R. (v.l. परि-प्ल्˚)
a class of gods in the 5th Manv-antara, Hariv.
पारि—प्लव n. N. of a Tīrtha, MBh.
पारि—प्लवा (आ), f. a small spoon used at sacrifices, Āryav. (cf. परि-प्लवा)
परि-प्लाव्य mfn. to be poured over, MBh.
पारि—प्लाव्य m. a goose, L.
पारि—प्लाव्य n. agitation, tremulousness, W.
परि-प्लुत mfn. bathed, one who has bathed in (loc. or comp.), MBh.
flooded, immersed, overwhelmed or visited by (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-प्लुत n. a spring, jump, Var.
परि-प्लुता (आ), f. spirituous liquor, L.
परि-प्लुष्ट mfn. (√ प्लुष्) burnt, scorched, singed, L.
परि-प्लोष m. burning, internal heat, Car.
परीप्स् ˚प्सा, ˚प्सु See पर्य्-आप्.
परीप्सा f. (fr. Desid.) desire of obtaining or preserving, MBh.
haste, hurry, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 52.
परीप्सु mfn. wishing to obtain or preserve, MBh.
desirous of finding out or ascertaining, Kir. iii, 4.
पारि—पाट्य n. (-पाटी) regularity, methodicalness, W.
पारि—पात्र &c. w.r. for -यात्र below.
पारि—पार्श्वक mf(इका)n. standing at the side attending on MBh.
पारि—पार्श्व—क m. (with or sc. नर) a servant, attendant, ib.
an assistant of the manager of a play, Bhar.
पारि—पार्श्विका f. (इका) a chamber-maid, Mālav.
पारि—पार्˚श्विक mfn. = ˚श्वक, R.; Mālav.
पारि—पेल n. = परि-पेलव, L.
पारि—प्लव—गत mfn. being in a boat, R.
पारि—प्लव—ता f. unsteadiness, inconstancy, Hcar.; Rājat.
पारि—प्लव—त्व n. unsteadiness, inconstancy, Hcar.; Rājat.
पारि—प्लव—दृष्टि (BhP.) or पारि—प्लव—नेत्र (Ragh.), mfn. having tremulous or swimming eyes
पारि—प्लव—दृष्टि (BhP.) or पारि—प्लव—नेत्र (Ragh.), mfn. having tremulous or swimming eyes
पारि—प्लव—प्रभ mfn. spreading tremulous lustre, R.
पारि—प्लव—मति mfn. fickle-minded, MBh.
पारि—प्लवीय n. an oblation connected with the recitation of a P˚ legend, ŚāṅkhŚr.
